Marta (CSM): Heads-up: Verdant activation scheduled for Fri 2026-06-12 08:30 PT. They want dedicated reserved capacity for their chat flow and a soft launch. Need final quota carve, burst policy, and the smokewalk plan. Renewal flagged as watch until first 72h.
Earl (Customer): Confirming target steady-state 1.1k QPS, burst up to 2.2k for <10m windows. Average prompt 90 tokens, some long series for workflows.
Chen (Infra Eng): Proposed carve: 4 x A100-equivalent GPUs reserved, pool reserved-q-verdant. Autoscale cushion +1 node for bursts. Which model variant?
Marta (CSM): Start with rw-0.9-fp16 for quality, can fallback to rw-0.9-int8 for cost under pressure.
Sam (SRE): Autoscale idea: maintain 60% GPU util target; scale when 2m rolling avg >72%; cool-down 6m. Add a short-burst policy to allow +25% capacity for 10m once per hour.
Nina (Solutions Eng): Loadtest outline: smokewalk (small run), then stress ramp. Steps: 1) priming (prefix populates), 2) smokewalk (50->500), 3) full ramp (500->2.2k), 4) soak (2.2k 20m). Example runner:
```bash
rdx-load \
  --endpoint https://api.redwood.test/v1/generate \
  --concurrency {{CONC}} \
  --qps {{Q}} \
  --payload samples/verdant_prompts.json \
  --inject-errors 5%\n```
Token mix: 80% short, 15% medium, 5% long. Include KV priming pass: 6k prefixes per primary route.
Chen (Infra Eng): Recommend batching: dynamic batching enabled, max_batch=192, preferred_lat_queue for routing /v1/chat. Also enable small request fast-path.
Sam (SRE): Monitoring + alerts: p95 > 900ms for 2 consecutive 1m windows -> escalate to on-call. p99 > 2.5s -> trigger automated route-shed and page. Also monitor GPU mem slack; if OOM ratio >0.5% in 10m -> degrade non-critical endpoints.
deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: verdant-reserved-pool create at 2026-06-12T08:25:00Z by @chen. Autoscale policy: verdant-autoscale-v2 applied.
Earl (Customer): We can postpone a marketing push by 30 minutes if needed. Appreciate a preflight run.
Marta (CSM): Action items: 1) Infra: confirm reserved nodes & max_batch (Chen). 2) SRE: add alerting + canary probe every 90s (Sam). 3) Solutions: stage load scripts, job links, and runbook sections (Nina). 4) CSM: organize 30m preflight call Thu 17:00 PT and collect feedback checkpoints at +6h, +24h, +72h (me).
Chen (Infra Eng): I'll validate max_batch=192 and run a priming job on staging Tue. Will also ensure fallback image for int8 is ready.
Nina (Solutions Eng): I'll post Jenkins job with three dry runs: priming-only, 50% smokewalk, and full dry run.
Sam (SRE): I'll add synthetic canary probes for /v1/health and /v1/generate, build Grafana panels, and document rollback steps: switch traffic to fp16, cap concurrency per-route to 400, and open incident.
Marta (CSM): Noted renewal risk: if activation is delayed >24h or first 24h has >2 critical incidents, flag immediate renewal outreach. I'll update the account health tracker. :clipboard:
Earl (Customer): We'll provide a small VIP test cohort for the first 12h. Thanks all.
Marta (CSM): Thanks team. Preflight invite sent. Add any hidden risks here and I'll fold into the kickoff checklist.
